title: Forensic Photo - Office Printer Job Log Timestamp Detail (EV002)
prompt:
1) Function: Produce a forensic-quality close-up photograph documenting the timestamp detail on an office printer job log display.
2) Scene / Composition: A color, documentary-style close-up of a generic office printer control panel showing the on-screen “Job Log” list with a single row centered and readable, focusing on one timestamp entry. The screen occupies ~70% of the frame, with the surrounding dark-gray plastic bezel and a few unbranded physical buttons visible for context. A small evidence annotation marker (simple white sticker with black text “EV002”) is placed on the printer bezel (not on the screen), and a small metric scale (10 cm) lies adjacent to the control panel edge within the frame. Lighting is forensic flash with even illumination and minimal glare; the display remains legible with no blown highlights.
3) Angle & Distance: angle 15° downward from perpendicular to the screen plane; distance_m 0.35.
4) Optics & Technique: 60 mm macro lens, f/11, 1/160 s, ISO 200, white balance 5000 K; focus locked on the timestamp characters; deep enough DOF to keep the full timestamp line sharp; use polarizing effect implied by controlled flash angle to reduce reflections without eliminating natural screen sheen.
5) Mandatory elements: On-screen text includes a clearly readable “Job Log” header and a visible timestamp field on one log row (timestamp format shown on the device UI, no added overlay). Visible evidence annotation “EV002” on a small sticker, and a metric scale showing centimeters.
6) Negatives: No people, faces, hands, fingerprints, or reflections showing a person; no brand names or logos; no real names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, or identifiable document titles; no added timestamps unrelated to the device UI; no caseId or evidenceId printed inside the image; no police/official badges; no QR codes or barcodes; no other devices or paperwork in view.
7) Acceptance checklist:
- The image is a single color photo with close-up perspective and forensic-flash look.
- The printer’s job log UI is legible and a single timestamp entry is clearly readable.
- The screen takes roughly 70% of the frame with surrounding bezel/buttons visible.
- A sticker reading “EV002” is visible on the bezel (not covering the screen).
- A 10 cm metric scale is visible and readable.
- No brands/logos, no people/biometrics, and no extra timestamps/labels are present.
